# art-kbd

## Overview

Kbd — shadcn/ui parity. A keyboard key, on the native `<kbd>` element. Group several with
`<art-kbd-group>` (⌘ + K).

## Slots

| Slot | Description                                                    |
| ---- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
|      | The key label; an `<art-icon size="sm">` or `<svg>` works too. |


## Shadow Parts

| Part    | Description         |
| ------- | ------------------- |
| `"kbd"` | The native `<kbd>`. |
